about: scripts/lanework/lanework.sh: a lane hands its branch back to the main checkout whatever push guard work put on its remotes. Each mutant restores one way push failed (2026-11-19) and a test of this package kills it.

mutants.name: lanework-push-by-remote
mutants.rule: push reaches the main checkout by its path, so work's guard on the main-checkout remote does not stop it.

mutants.name: lanework-create-keeps-guard
mutants.rule: A lane create makes guards origin only; main-checkout, its push remote, takes a plain git push.
